messages.subject: marker genomic position information
parts:
All:

How can I access marker genomic position information? like
"SNP_A-183410, chromosome 11, start 12345,"

Thanks;

Han

messages.author: a5f6afcbe5b17914
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] marker genomic position information
parts:
Hi,

the mapping from unit name to unit index is in the CDF, e.g.

cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("Mapping250K_Nsp");
unitNames <- c("SNP_A-1784942", "SNP_A-2169417");
units <- indexOf(cdf, names=unitNames);

the mapping from unit index to genomic position is in the UGP, e.g.

ugp <- getAromaUgpFile(cdf);
data <- ugp[units,,drop=FALSE];
print(data);
chromosome position
1 6 65097728
2 11 34497717
str(data);
'data.frame': 2 obs. of 2 variables:
$ chromosome: int 6 11
$ position : int 65097728 34497717

More fancy output:

rownames(data) <- unitNames;
print(data);
chromosome position
SNP_A-1784942 6 65097728
SNP_A-2169417 11 34497717

/Henrik
